text: Implemented dataset-zarr: portable BIDS acquisition identity and canonical selection lowering; JVM ZarrResponseBlockSource over generic point plans with ordered time-by-voxel calibration; streaming raw-scalar NIfTI importer for uint8/int16/int32/float32/float64; immutable publication; raw-dtype NIfTI/BIDS exporter; and fit-chunk selection execution without whole-run materialization. Gates: datasetZarrJVM 5/5, datasetZarrJS 2/2. Independent nibabel matrix matched stored values, calibrated values, dtype, affine, slope/intercept, shape, and TR for all five dtypes. bids-validator 1.15.0 returned zero errors on export (recommendation warnings only). BIDS permits .nii and recommends .nii.gz; tiny uncompressed oracle avoids the legacy validator compressed-size false positive.
